summary: cto checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: CTO disposition: maintain containment-only execution. No new implementation, requeue, deployment, dependency, credential, telemetry, spend, experiment, or monetization change is queue-eligible this cycle. Continue existing repair-or-close, measurement, attribution, legal, security, and financial reconciliation work using recorded evidence only. Preserve deferred SEO, UX, affiliate, performance, and content opportunities with their existing metrics, tests, measurement windows, and rollback notes. Treat revenue, ROI, margin, payback, cost-to-learn, budget capacity, and causal lift as unknown; retain aggregate provider commission as unattributed. Reconsider new queue work only after dated ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, deduplication, release, security, and measurement evidence is recorded.

Handoff: record dated unblock evidence for existing failed and measuring work by the established deadline. Do not requeue or duplicate work until ownership, root cause, isolated validation, rollback, deduplication, release, security, attribution, and measurement evidence is attached.

Handoff: continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Preserve private launch gates and record explicit unknowns; do not access credentials, alter permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, or conduct external outreach.

Handoff: continue the existing launch-readiness evidence work and keep rights-dependent public exposure and external permission outreach blocked pending human-counsel review and owner authorization. Do not close a gate without its required evidence.

Handoff: continue the existing period-aligned revenue, attribution, and cost reconciliation only. Preserve aggregate provider earnings as unattributed and do not infer site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, budget capacity, cost-to-learn, or causal lift from incomplete periods or activity counts.
